info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Customer Campaign Execution Review-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the submission of reviews for customer campaign executions. It allows businesses to gather feedback on their marketing campaigns, enabling them to assess effectiveness and understand customer sentiment. Primary resources include customer campaign execution records and their associated reviews. This functionality is essential for marketing teams looking to enhance campaign performance based on real-time feedback. Typical consumers of this API are marketing analysts and campaign managers in finance or banking sectors.

post.summary: Submit a review for Customer Campaign Execution.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review related to a specific customer campaign execution identified by its ID. Providing valuable feedback helps improve future campaigns and enhances customer engagement.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit reviews for a specific customer campaign execution. The payload should contain all necessary details about the reviews to be associated with the campaign, following the defined schema.
